body.p: **This is sample text.** It shows what a text block can hold (headings, lists, bold, italics and a link) and is nobody’s real policy, CaraCMS’s included. Replace it with your own before the site goes live.
This policy explains what this site collects when you use it or get in touch, and what we do with it.
We only collect what you give us, and a little about how the site is used:

ul: your name, email address and message when you use the contact form;
anything you send us by email or tell us on the phone;
anonymous visit statistics, such as which pages are read most.

body.p: We use your details **only to reply to you**. We never sell them, and we don’t add you to a mailing list unless you ask.

ol: Your message arrives in our inbox and in the site’s editor.
One of us replies, usually within a day.
After a year without contact, we delete it.

body.p: You can ask to see, correct or delete anything we hold about you, and we’ll answer within a month, as *the GDPR* asks.
Questions about this policy go to [privacy@example.com](mailto:privacy@example.com).
